comment: DnrK also known as Carminomycin 4-O-methyltransferase is involved in the biosynthesis of anthracycline daunorubicin.

changelog.comment: New entry. Daunorubicin is an intermediate for the endproduct Doxorubicin.

reactions.description: DnrK catalyzes the methylation of the 4-hydroxyl group in tetracyclic ring system of carminomycin to form daunorubicin
DnrK has a broad substrate specificity and can methylate other anthracyclines in addition to carminomycin, for instance ϵ-rhodomycin T
